_: Per-package test-duration budget for the CI timing gate (kata b6rv, see docs/testing.md). Sums are seconds of go test -json output (top-level Test/Example results only, on the same non-fuzz gate surface run-module-tests.sh proves) and, for the frontend, the vitest JSON reporter's assertion durations rolled up under the single key "web". scripts/test-timing-budget.sh compares a fresh measurement against these numbers: fail at 1.5x the budget, warn at 1.1x (strict in CI, warn-only on a local run) plus a flat per-test ceiling regardless of package. Raise a budget by editing this file in the same commit as the change that earned the increase, or run `make test-rebaseline` to reset every listed package to what a clean-host run just measured. Empty until the controller lands that clean-host baseline (kata b6rv); until then every package reads as having no budget yet and the gate stays warn-only everywhere, CI included.
